title: How to Check Windows Update
overview: This article supports the Check Windows Update step in the Computer Running Slowly workflow. It explains how to check for available Windows updates, determine whether updates are pending, and identify whether a restart is required before continuing performance troubleshooting.
checklist: Save any open work before checking for updates.
Review whether updates are available, downloading, installing, or require a restart.
If updates are available, allow Windows to download and install them according to your organization's update policy.
Restart the computer if Windows indicates a restart is required.
Verify Windows Update reports that the device is up to date or document any pending updates.
Record the update status and return to the troubleshooting workflow.
common_indicators: Windows reports the device is up to date.
A restart is required to complete installation.
Windows Update displays an error or requires troubleshooting.

commands.description: Opens the Windows Update page in Settings.

quiz.question: What should you verify before continuing performance troubleshooting?
answers: Whether Windows is up to date or requires a restart.
quiz.correct_answer: Whether Windows is up to date or requires a restart.
